workflow-optimizer v0.1.0

- Initial release of an intelligent workflow optimization engine for AI workflows and skill orchestration.
- Provides workflow analysis, bottleneck identification, performance optimization recommendations, and automated optimization execution.
- Supports both manual and automated optimization with rollback options.
- Includes usage scenarios and tiered pricing for individuals, teams, and enterprises.
- Designed to improve workflow efficiency, reduce resource usage, and lower operational costs.
